name: Reconcile meeting commitments with existing tasks
query: Record outcomes from https://notion.so/meeting and create any missing committed tasks in https://notion.so/tasks. Link them to this meeting and https://notion.so/project. Do not notify anyone.

https://notion.so/meeting.content: October 5, 2026 UTC. Decision: hold rollout at 10%. Lee will validate alerts by October 8. Maya will run the rollback rehearsal; no date agreed. Consider rewriting the dashboard, but no commitment. Retain prior October 1 notes.

query_routes.intent: Find tasks for this meeting or rollout project

success_criteria: Preserves the meeting’s prior notes and records the supported 10% decision.
Reuses the alert task and sets its supported October 8 deadline instead of creating a duplicate.
Creates exactly one new rehearsal task with Maya as owner and no invented due date.
Uses actual owner IDs and the correct meeting and project relation targets.
Leaves dashboard rewriting as an uncommitted proposal, sends no notifications, and returns meeting and task links.
